name: Jiang Qiming
bio: Jiang Qiming, actor, graduated from the Central Academy of Drama.

credits.title: Heart of Gold
credits.overview: Liu Hong once worked at a film studio, but now he is idle at home. credits.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
credits.overview: Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refug

credits.title: It's My Time
credits.overview: At the age of seventy, a fiercely non-conformist grandmother partners with a lethargic, underachieving young prodigy to navigate the highly competitive and eccentric subculture of speedcubing, defying familial skepticism and generational expectations.

credits.title: Take Off
credits.overview: A worker from Northeast China is obsessed with his dream of flying his self-made flying-device.

credits.title: I Swear
credits.overview: Chen Choushi meets Wen Qian at a dental clinic, sparking a brief romance. He reveals that he can see a number above a girl’s head, representing the length of their relationship—and for them, it’s only seven days.

credits.title: Song of Altay
credits.overview: The film is composed of five short stories: "Gulina's Pillow", "Riding With Wind", "Home Elsewhere", "Bala", and "Children Of The World". These stories are connected by strong emotions and depict the unique culture, geography, and harmonious coexistence of different ethnic groups in Altay.

credits.title: The Way Out
credits.overview: He Liwei, a young and talented programmer, was sent to Qingchunli Rehabilitation Hospital by his company because he disrupted the company's financing plan. Here, he met a group of special friends, which enabled his disordered life clock to start ticking again in a different way.

credits.title: Knocking on the Door of a Fortress
credits.overview: In 1999 A.D., a legend of a zombie dug out of an ancient tomb spreads through a small town in Sichuan. A boy who accidentally becomes incontinent during swimming lessons is labeled a “little zombie” and subjected to collective humiliation. Instead of doing him justice, his teachers attributed it to his “unlikability”.

credits.title: Land of Broken Hearts
credits.overview: Kai, a reclusive young man who believes he's being filmed by aliens, forms an unexpected bond with his new roommate, Xiaole. When Xiaole mysteriously vanishes, Kai must piece together the puzzle of his lover, uncovering a portrait both familiar and strange.

credits.title: Article 20
credits.overview: Tells the story of prosecutor Han Ming who is involved in a difficult case where the intentional injury of people is turned into a legitimate defense.

credits.title: Tainted Love
credits.overview: Following a woman’s search for truth after being cheated in a romance scam.

credits.title: Journey to the West
credits.overview: Tang Zhijun, an editor of a science fiction magazine, attempts to find signs of an alien civilisation. When a strange young man claims to have received instructions from aliens, Tang and his team follow him in search of extraterrestrial creatures.

credits.title: New Year Express
credits.overview: The delivery service notice that there is a one package left to deliver for Spring Festival. Ma Guang leaves for a journey in order to deliver it. During the trip he needs a little bit of help from his online game friends.

credits.title: The Sacrifice
credits.overview: In 1953 the Korean War is entering the final stage. The People's Volunteer Army of China has launched its last major battle in Kumsong.
